note: Ratings are fan-estimated MCU power levels, just for fun.

characters.name: Iron Man
characters.description: A billionaire inventor who builds a powered suit of armour and turns his genius toward protecting the world.
characters.importance: Iron Man kicked off the entire Marvel Cinematic Universe and set its tone: witty, high-tech and full of heart. His choices and inventions ripple through many of the stories that follow.

characters.name: Captain America
characters.description: A determined soldier transformed by an experimental serum into the peak of human ability, carrying a near-indestructible shield.
characters.importance: Cap is the moral compass of the team, a symbol of courage and old-fashioned decency. His leadership holds the Avengers together when things get complicated.

characters.name: Thor
characters.description: The mighty Asgardian god of thunder, wielding lightning and a hammer-forged weapon that answers only to the worthy.
characters.importance: Thor connects Earth to the wider cosmos of gods and realms. His storylines open the door to magic, mythology and the larger cosmic threats in the MCU.

characters.name: Hulk
characters.tagline: Puny humans, meet the Other Guy.
characters.description: A brilliant scientist whose gamma-radiation accident unleashes a towering green powerhouse when his anger rises.
characters.importance: The Hulk is one of the most physically powerful heroes in the MCU and a constant reminder that the biggest battles can be internal. Banner's science and Hulk's might make for a unique double act.

characters.name: Black Widow
characters.description: A master spy and martial artist with a shadowy past, she fights with pure skill rather than super powers.
characters.importance: Natasha is the glue of the early Avengers: a strategist and infiltrator who keeps the team grounded. Her history is full of secrets that drive many stories.

characters.name: Hawkeye
characters.description: A peerless archer who never misses, armed with an arsenal of specialised trick arrows.
characters.importance: Clint proves you do not need powers to be a hero. As a family man among gods and monsters, he brings the team a very human perspective.

characters.name: Spider-Man
characters.description: A teenage New Yorker with spider-like powers who swings through the city balancing homework and heroics.
characters.importance: Spider-Man brings youth, humour and relatability to the MCU. He shows the everyday-hero side of the universe and grows a lot under the mentors he meets.

characters.name: Black Panther
characters.description: The king and protector of Wakanda, wearing a suit of vibranium and blending tradition with cutting-edge tech.
characters.importance: T'Challa introduces Wakanda, the most advanced nation on Earth, and the power of the vibranium metal. His reign raises big questions about how a leader should use power.

characters.name: Doctor Strange
characters.description: A gifted surgeon who discovers the mystic arts and becomes Earth's Sorcerer Supreme.
characters.importance: Strange opens up magic and the multiverse in the MCU. He is often the one who sees the wider picture and understands what is truly at stake.

characters.name: Captain Marvel
characters.description: A former pilot infused with cosmic energy, she flies faster than sound and fires powerful energy blasts.
characters.importance: Carol is among the most powerful heroes in the MCU and connects Earth's story to the galactic community. Her origin also fills in important history about the early days of S.H.I.E.L.D.

characters.name: Ant-Man
characters.description: A clever ex-thief who wears a suit that lets him shrink to insect size or grow to giant scale.
characters.importance: Scott brings a lighter, heist-movie flavour to the MCU and opens the door to the mysterious Quantum Realm. His small-scale tricks have surprisingly big consequences.

characters.name: Wasp
characters.description: A skilled fighter who shrinks to tiny size with wings and stinging energy blasts.
characters.importance: Hope is a capable hero and a scientist in her own right, and her family history is tied to the shrinking technology that powers the Ant-Man stories.

characters.name: Scarlet Witch
characters.description: A woman with remarkable reality-bending magic, whose crimson energy can move objects and warp minds.
characters.importance: Wanda is one of the most powerful beings in the MCU, and her emotional journey is central to several stories. Her abilities hint at forces few characters fully understand.

characters.name: Vision
characters.description: A synthetic being with a glowing gem on his brow, combining artificial intelligence with extraordinary abilities.
characters.importance: Vision explores what it means to be alive and what makes someone human. He is powerful yet gentle and often the calm voice among the Avengers.

characters.name: Falcon
characters.description: A former Air Force pararescue specialist who soars the skies with a high-tech winged flight suit.
characters.importance: Sam is a dependable friend and skilled mentor figure who brings a grounded perspective and heart. He proves leadership is about people, not power.

characters.name: Winter Soldier
characters.description: A highly trained soldier with a metal arm and a long, complicated history alongside Steve Rogers.
characters.importance: Bucky's tie to Captain America gives the MCU some of its most personal stories. His journey is about finding who he is after a lot of hardship.

characters.name: War Machine
characters.description: A loyal Air Force officer and friend of Tony Stark who pilots a heavily armed armoured suit.
characters.importance: Rhodey is the dependable military mind among the heroes and a steady friend. He brings the heavy weaponry and a no-nonsense attitude.

characters.name: Loki
characters.description: A silver-tongued Asgardian trickster who uses illusions and cunning to get what he wants.
characters.importance: Loki is the MCU's most memorable troublemaker and a constant wild card. Charming, unpredictable and hard to pin down, he keeps every story he joins fun.

characters.name: Thanos
characters.description: A towering cosmic warlord obsessed with a grand plan and a golden gauntlet that holds six powerful stones.
characters.importance: Thanos is the biggest threat of the Infinity Saga, and his shadow looms over many films. He turns an entire run of stories into a single epic quest.

characters.name: Star-Lord
characters.description: A charming space outlaw raised among Ravagers, armed with element guns and a classic mixtape.
characters.importance: Quill leads the ragtag Guardians. He brings humour, heart and a love for 80s music to the cosmic side of the MCU.

characters.name: Gamora
characters.description: A deadly, highly trained assassin known as the most dangerous woman in the galaxy.
characters.importance: Gamora's combat skill and moral grit make her the serious heart of the Guardians. Her past is intertwined with some of the galaxy's biggest players.

characters.name: Drax
characters.description: A powerful warrior driven by a vow of vengeance who takes everything extremely literally.
characters.importance: Drax delivers big laughs and big punches. His loyalty and surprising warmth make him a fan favourite among the Guardians.

characters.name: Rocket
characters.description: A sharp-tongued, genetically enhanced raccoon with a gift for weapons and engineering.
characters.importance: Rocket is the team's tinkerer and heart behind the prickly exterior. He shows that clever minds are as valuable as raw power.

characters.name: Groot
characters.description: A gentle tree-like being who speaks only three words but can grow, stretch and shield his friends.
characters.importance: Groot is the soft-hearted muscle of the Guardians. His simple loyalty and growing character arc make him one of the most beloved members.

characters.name: Nebula
characters.description: A fierce cyborg warrior with a blue-skinned, battle-hardened past and a prickly, loyal streak.
characters.importance: Nebula's path is one of the MCU's most interesting character growth journeys. She brings toughness and unexpected depth to every team she joins.

characters.name: Mantis
characters.description: A sweet, sensitive empath who can sense and soothe the feelings of others.
characters.importance: Mantis adds warmth and awkward humour to the Guardians. Her gentle power shows there is more than one way to win a fight.

characters.name: Shang-Chi

firstAppearance.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

characters.description: A gifted martial artist who trained from childhood and wields ten mystical rings.
characters.importance: Shang-Chi brings martial-arts flair and a new cultural backdrop to the MCU. His story opens a fresh corner of the universe full of legends and magic.

characters.name: Wong
characters.description: A serious, dry-witted master of the mystic arts and protector of ancient sorcerous texts.
characters.importance: Wong anchors the magical side of the MCU. He is a steady ally, a teacher and a powerful sorcerer in his own right.

characters.name: Ultron
characters.tagline: There are no strings on me.
characters.description: A self-aware artificial intelligence with a metallic body and some very strong opinions about humanity.
characters.importance: Ultron shows how technology meant to protect can go badly wrong. He is a tech-driven threat that tests the Avengers as a team.

characters.name: Hela
characters.description: The Asgardian Goddess of Death, armed with conjured blades and a hunger for conquest.
characters.importance: Hela is a fearsome force whose arrival shakes up Thor's world. She proves that power in the MCU can come from ancient, deep-rooted sources.

characters.name: Killmonger
characters.description: A skilled operative with a formidable military background and a personal mission to change Wakanda.
characters.importance: Killmonger is praised as one of the MCU's best-written antagonists, with a goal that makes the audience think. His story challenges what a hero is supposed to do.

characters.name: Ego
characters.description: An ancient cosmic being of staggering power who crosses paths with the Guardians.
characters.importance: Ego expands the MCU's cosmic scale and shows just how big the universe can get. His arrival gives the Guardians' second adventure a huge sense of scale.

characters.name: Red Skull
characters.description: The ruthless head of an elite science division, driven by an obsession with powerful artefacts.
characters.importance: Red Skull is Captain America's first big opponent and ties the MCU to its earliest mysteries. His hunt for ancient power sets up themes that echo later.

characters.name: Ronan
characters.description: A fanatical Kree warrior with a giant war hammer and a fierce devotion to his cause.
characters.importance: Ronan is the first major cosmic threat the Guardians face. He shows the brutal side of galactic politics and raises the stakes of their first adventure.

characters.name: Kang
characters.description: A cunning time-travelling conqueror with powerful future technology and a patient, strategic mind.
characters.importance: Kang is set up as a big multiversal threat. He brings the idea of time and alternate realities into the forefront of the MCU.

characters.name: Namor
characters.description: The proud ruler of a hidden underwater kingdom, blessed with flight, strength and lightning-fast reflexes.
characters.importance: Namor introduces a whole new civilisation beneath the waves. His fierce protectiveness makes him a formidable and complicated figure.

characters.name: Ms. Marvel
characters.tagline: Good is not a thing you are.
characters.description: A high-school fan of the Avengers who discovers light-based powers of her own.
characters.importance: Kamala brings fresh, youthful energy and a joyous new perspective. Her story is about growing into your own identity.

characters.name: She-Hulk
characters.description: A sharp lawyer who can transform into an emerald powerhouse while keeping her confidence and composure.
characters.importance: She-Hulk adds comedy, courtroom drama and meta-humour to the MCU. She shows a fun, more relaxed side of super-heroing.

characters.name: Moon Knight
characters.description: A mysterious vigilante empowered by an ancient Egyptian moon god, with a complicated inner life.
characters.importance: Moon Knight pushes the MCU into darker, more mythological territory. His stories blend mystery with psychological tension.

characters.name: Daredevil
characters.description: A blind lawyer by day who patrols Hell's Kitchen at night with heightened senses and a mean right hook.
characters.importance: Daredevil represents the street-level, gritty corner of the MCU. His stories are about justice on a very human scale.

characters.name: Deadpool
characters.description: A fast-talking mercenary with an unstoppable healing ability and a habit of talking straight to the audience.
characters.importance: Deadpool brings irreverent, fourth-wall-breaking comedy to the wider Marvel world. He first starred in a separate film series before joining the MCU.

characters.name: Gorr
characters.description: A haunted being armed with a cursed blade and a determination to challenge the gods.
characters.importance: Gorr is a chilling threat who is unlike Thor's earlier foes. His motives add emotional depth to the god-filled world of Asgardians.

characters.name: Dormammu
characters.description: An ancient, colossal being from the Dark Dimension who seeks to expand his domain.
characters.importance: Dormammu represents the vast, terrifying end of the MCU's magic. His presence raises the stakes of any mystic battle.

characters.name: Odin
characters.description: The wise and powerful All-Father and king of Asgard, guardian of the Nine Realms.
characters.importance: Odin is the ruler whose decisions shape Thor's life and the long history of the Asgardians. He embodies ancient power and old-world authority.
